svg.content:
<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="58cA7xexdre4Gz58YzqO"> <mxGraphModel dx="1032" dy="809" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "flowchart TD
 classDef startEnd fill:#cfd8dc,stroke:#37474f,stroke-width:2px;
 classDef action fill:#bbdefb,stroke:#1976d2,stroke-width:2px;
 classDef decision fill:#fff9c4,stroke:#fbc02d,stroke-width:2px;
 classDef failure fill:#ffcdd2,stroke:#d32f2f,stroke-width:2px;
 classDef success fill:#c8e6c9,stroke:#388e3c,stroke-width:2px;

 subgraph OfflineSync[\"Offline Capture & Local Queue Engine\"]
 S1([Field Event Captured Offline]):::startEnd --> S2[Persist Complete Record to Local Storage Immediately]:::action
 S2 --> S3[Assign Unique Stable Event Identifier]:::action
 S3 --> S4[Add Record & Media Attachments to Local Synchronization Queue]:::action
 S4 --> S5[Expose 'Pending Sync' Status on Mobile App UI]:::action

 S5 --> D_Net{Network Connectivity Available?}:::decision
 D_Net -- No --> S6[Retain Record in Queue; Continue Field Operations Offline]:::action
 S6 --> D_Net

 D_Net -- Yes --> S7[Initiate Auto-Sync Transmission to Backend API]:::action
 S7 --> S8[Server Validates Record Integrity, Signatures & Idempotent Event ID]:::action

 S8 --> D_Valid{Server Validation Passed?}:::decision

 D_Valid -- Duplicate / Retransmission --> S9[Acknowledge Request; Ignore Duplicate Storage]:::success
 D_Valid -- Rejected / Failed --> F_Sync[Mark Local Queue Item as Failed; Retain for Resolution]:::failure

 D_Valid -- Yes / New Record --> S10[Persist Record in Central Relational DB & Media in Object Storage]:::success
 S10 --> S11[Update Mobile Queue Status to 'Synchronized']:::success
 S9 --> S11
 S11 --> S12([Local Synchronization Complete]):::startEnd
 end

 subgraph AdminDashboard[\"Administrative Dashboard Oversight & Anomaly Management\"]
 D_Start([User Opens Web Dashboard]):::startEnd --> D_View{Select Dashboard View}:::decision

 D_View -- Attendance --> V1[View Live Synchronized Attendance & Calculated Worked Hours]:::action
 D_View -- Reports --> V2[Access Chronological Site Progress Report Archive]:::action
 D_View -- Fleet --> V3[View Live Map Position of Open Sessions, Route History & Condition Log]:::action
 D_View -- Audit Trail --> V4[Review Immutable Audit Trail for Site Creation & Modifications]:::action

 D_View -- Flagged Events Queue --> V5[Inspect System Flagged Anomalies]:::action

 V5 --> D_FlagType{Flagged Anomaly Category?}:::decision

 D_FlagType -- Mock Location --> F_A1[Review Mock-Location Detection Context & GPS Data]:::failure
 D_FlagType -- Failed Liveness --> F_A2[Review Failed Liveness Verification Attempts]:::failure
 D_FlagType -- Missed Shift Report --> F_A3[Review Escalated Missed 12-Hour Shift Report Alert]:::failure
 D_FlagType -- Incident / HSE --> F_A4[Review Incident / Equipment Failure Notes & Attachments]:::failure
 D_FlagType -- Vehicle Fault --> F_A5[Review Vehicle Fault Alert & Inspection Evidence]:::failure

 F_A1 --> AdmAct[Take Administrative Action e.g., Deactivate Site, Resolve Dispute, Dispatch Maintenance]:::action
 F_A2 --> AdmAct
 F_A3 --> AdmAct
 F_A4 --> AdmAct
 F_A5 --> AdmAct

 V1 --> D_End([Dashboard Oversight Complete]):::startEnd
 V2 --> D_End
 V3 --> D_End
 V4 --> D_End
 AdmAct --> D_End
 end",
 "config": null,
 "version": "12"
